en: a. having a serious, important or useful purpose; (of a look or action) expressing a hidden meaning; worth doing or having
ex: She wants to find a more meaningful job.
她想找一份更有意義的工作。

en: adv. during the time that something else is happening; in the period of time between two events; n. the time between two events
ex: I'll cook dinner; meanwhile, you can set the table.
我來煮晚餐，你同時可以擺餐具。

en: n. a small flat piece of metal, often shaped like a coin, given to someone as an award for winning a competition or being brave; v. to give someone a medal
ex: She won a gold medal at the Olympics.
她在奧運會上贏得了一面金牌。

en: n. a way of communicating or doing something; the material or form through which something is expressed; (plural media) newspapers, television, radio and the internet; a. of middle size or degree; (of meat) cooked until it is only slightly pink
ex: Television is a powerful medium for advertising.
電視是強大的廣告媒介。

en: n. a large round fruit with a hard skin, a lot of juicy flesh and many seeds; (slang) a very large amount of profit shared among shareholders
ex: We had cold melon for dessert in the summer.
夏天我們吃冰涼的甜瓜當甜點。

en: a. relating to the mind; relating to the process of thinking; (informal) crazy; n. a person with a mental illness
ex: Regular exercise is good for your mental health.
規律運動對心理健康有益。

en: a. cheerful and happy; (informal) slightly drunk; used to wish someone a happy time at Christmas
ex: We wish you a merry Christmas and a happy new year.
祝你聖誕快樂、新年快樂。

en: n. a dirty or untidy state; a difficult or confusing situation; a place where soldiers eat; v. to make a place untidy or dirty; (mess up) to do something badly; (mess with) to interfere with something
ex: Your room is a mess; please clean it up.
你的房間一團亂，請整理乾淨。

en: a piece of electronic equipment that makes sounds louder or records them
ex: The singer stepped up to the microphone and began to sing.
歌手走到麥克風前開始唱歌。

en: n. a kitchen oven that cooks food very quickly using electromagnetic waves; a type of radio wave with a very short wavelength; v. to cook or heat food in a microwave oven
ex: Heat the soup in the microwave for two minutes.
把湯放進微波爐加熱兩分鐘。

en: prep. used to show that a number is subtracted; without; n. a minus sign; a disadvantage; a. less than zero; slightly below a particular grade
ex: Ten minus four is six.
十減四等於六。

en: n. an event that cannot be explained by natural laws and is believed to be caused by a god; something very lucky or surprising; a wonderful example of something
ex: It was a miracle that nobody was hurt in the accident.
這場意外沒人受傷真是奇蹟。

en: n. a state of great unhappiness or suffering; something that causes great unhappiness; (informal) a person who is always unhappy
ex: The war brought great misery to many families.
戰爭給許多家庭帶來極大的痛苦。
ph: put someone out of their misery

en: n. a weapon that is fired through the air and explodes when it hits its target; any object that is thrown or fired; a. able to be thrown or fired
ex: The army tested a long-range missile yesterday.
軍方昨天試射了一枚遠程飛彈。

en: n. an important job that someone is sent to do; a group of people who are sent to another country for a special purpose; a strong feeling that you have a duty to do something; a place where missionaries work; v. to send someone on a mission
ex: The astronauts began their mission to Mars.
太空人展開前往火星的任務。

en: n. a cloud of very small drops of water in the air close to the ground, less thick than fog; a fine spray of liquid; v. to spray something with a fine mist; to become covered with small drops of water
ex: A light mist hung over the valley early in the morning.
清晨山谷上方籠罩著一層薄霧。
ph: lost in the mists of time

en: n. a large crowd of people, especially one that may become violent; (the Mob) a criminal organization; v. to gather around someone in a large crowd; to crowd into a place
ex: An angry mob gathered outside the building.
一群憤怒的群眾聚集在大樓外面。

en: a. able to move or be moved easily; (of people) able to travel easily; able to change quickly; n. a decoration that hangs from a string and moves in the air; (UK) a cell phone
ex: A mobile library visits our village every week.
流動圖書館每週都會來我們村裡。

en: a. slightly wet; (of food) soft and not dry; (of weather) rainy; (of eyes) full of tears
ex: The cake was soft and moist.
蛋糕又軟又濕潤。

en: a man who lives in a religious community and has made promises to give up worldly things and to devote his life to religion
ex: The monk lives a simple life in the mountain temple.
那位僧侶在山中的寺廟過著簡樸的生活。

en: n. an imaginary frightening creature in stories; a very cruel person; something very large; a. very big (informal)
ex: The children were scared of the monster under the bed.
孩子們害怕床底下的怪物。

en: a. happening or paid once a month; n. a magazine that is published once a month; adv. once a month
ex: The club holds a monthly meeting.
俱樂部每月開一次會。

en: a. relating to what is right and wrong; behaving in a good and honest way; n. a lesson about what is right and wrong that you learn from a story or experience; (morals) principles of good behavior
ex: It is not moral to lie to your friends.
對朋友說謊是不道德的。

en: adv. mainly; in most cases; for the most part
ex: The class is mostly girls, with just a few boys.
這個班級大多是女生，只有幾個男生。

en: n. a flying insect with large wings, similar to a butterfly, that is active at night and is attracted to light; a small insect whose larvae eat holes in wool clothes
ex: A moth kept flying around the lamp.
一隻飛蛾一直繞著燈飛。

en: n. a machine that uses fuel or electricity to produce movement; (UK) a car; a. relating to cars or engines; relating to movement of muscles; v. to travel by car
ex: The motor of the washing machine stopped working.
洗衣機的馬達壞了。

en: n. the crime of deliberately killing a person; (informal) something very difficult or unpleasant; v. to deliberately kill a person; (informal) to spoil something badly
ex: The police are investigating a murder in the city center.
警方正在調查市中心的一起謀殺案。

en: n. a piece of soft tissue in the body that you can tighten to make your body move; the power or strength of your body; political or economic power
ex: He exercised regularly to build up his muscles.
他規律運動來增加肌肉量。

en: a. not wearing any clothes; (of a feeling or fact) plain and true, with nothing hidden; not protected or covered
ex: The baby ran around the room completely naked.
寶寶一絲不掛地在房間裡跑來跑去。

en: n. a short sleep, especially during the day; v. to sleep for a short time, especially during the day; (in horse racing) to choose a horse to win
ex: He took a short nap after lunch.
他午餐後小睡了一下。

en: a piece of cloth or paper used at meals to protect your clothes or to wipe your hands and mouth; (UK) a diaper
ex: Please put a napkin on your lap before eating.
吃飯前請把餐巾放在腿上。

en: n. a person who was born in a particular place; an animal or plant that originally lived in a place; a. born in a particular place; (of an ability) existing from birth; belonging to a particular place
ex: She is a native of Taipei and speaks fluent Chinese.
她是台北人，說一口流利的中文。

en: n. the part of a country's armed forces that fights at sea; the ships and sailors of a country; (also navy blue) a very dark blue color
ex: He joined the navy when he was eighteen.
他十八歲時加入海軍。

en: n. the area around a place where people live; the people who live in a particular area; the area near a particular place
ex: There is a nice park in our neighborhood.
我們社區附近有一座很棒的公園。

en: n. a home that a bird builds with twigs, grass and mud to lay its eggs in; a place where some small animals or insects live; a cozy place; v. to build or use a nest; to fit one thing inside another
ex: The bird built a nest in the tree.
那隻鳥在樹上築了一個巢。

en: a person who writes novels
ex: The novelist spent three years writing her first book.
那位小說家花了三年寫她的第一本書。

en: a woman who has joined a religious community and has promised to serve God, and lives away from other people
ex: The nun taught at the school for thirty years.
那位修女在學校教書三十年。

en: n. a large tree that produces acorns and has hard wood that is used to make furniture and ships; the wood of this tree; a. made of oak
ex: The old oak tree has stood in the field for centuries.
那棵老橡樹在田野上屹立了好幾個世紀。
ph: mighty oaks from little acorns grow

en: n. a time when something happens; a special event; a good time or chance to do something; a reason to do something; v. to cause something to happen (formal)
ex: We wear formal clothes for special occasions.
我們在特殊場合穿正式服裝。

en: a. strange or unusual; (of a number) not able to be divided exactly by two; occasional; not part of a pair or set; n. (the odds) the chance that something will happen
ex: It's odd that he didn't call us back.
奇怪的是他沒有回我們電話。
